hotels.title: A Contemporary Escape in Delhi’s Aerocity
hotels.description: Set in Delhi’s polished Aerocity precinct, this contemporary retreat places you minutes from Indira Gandhi International Airport and within easy reach of the capital’s diplomatic enclave and Qutub Minar. Sleek rooms and suites pair modern lines with generous city views, creating a refined base between flights or days of discovery. Spend time by the outdoor pool, book a treatment at the spa or settle into the fitness centre before dinner at Food Exchange, known for global plates and live kitchens. Worldmark’s restaurants and cafés are close by, while India Gate, Humayun’s Tomb and the boutiques of DLF Emporio are all within driving distance
